artifact.statement: Returning customers lose progress when interrupting onboarding, requiring repeated steps.
artifact.mechanism: Implement save-progress feature using local storage to persist onboarding state
artifact.title: Save Progress for Returning Customers
artifact.summary: Save-progress feature will retain user progress between sessions, allowing returning customers to resume onboarding where they left off. This addresses the pain point of lost progress when interrupting the onboarding flow.
